topic: Promo carousel for the live video "Pieverse Went From 12 Cents to $2: Here's What It Actually Is"
body_style: watch-the-full-video link + headline + two arrow points + hashtags
body:
▶ Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/7x2CVZQG6WQ

$PIEVERSE went from around 12 cents to $2 in under a year. Here's what it actually is.

→ An agent you rent inside Line or Kakao, for $10 to $279 a month
→ No agent count, subscriber count or revenue published that I could find

#Pieverse #AIAgents #Crypto

images.slide_text: It didn't start as AI agents
Mostly imported skills / 30 / Out of around 74,000 listed, almost all are imported from an outside catalog called ClawHub.
The number I couldn't find / How many agents are running? There's no published agent count, subscriber count or revenue, anywhere I checked.
A new all-time high / From around 62 cents to 1.18 dollars around the Upbit listing, then 2.23 dollars on November 9th, 2026.
Who's behind it / 7M / Led by Animoca Brands and UOB Ventures, and raised for payments and compliance, not for chat app agents.
Priced way ahead / My read: Pieverse is a live product with real backers, priced way ahead of the numbers it publishes.
Watch the full video / Pieverse: Here's What It Actually Is
